questions.stem_text: The native peoples of the northwest coast of North America were:
questions.answer_explanation: The native peoples of the northwest coast of North America were classified as simple foragers because they primarily relied on hunting, fishing, and gathering from the abundant natural resources in their environment, rather than engaging in agriculture or complex economic systems.
